intro.title: Design Notification System
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a notification system component that displays alert messages to users. You will learn how to manage multiple notifications using React state hooks to track which messages are currently visible. The core concept involves creating a reusable component that can show different types of notifications (like success, warning, or error) with proper styling. You'll use TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of notification objects and React event handlers to control when notifications appear and disappear. By the end, you'll have a functional notification system that can be integrated into any React application.
intro.usecase: Notification systems are fundamental to modern web applications, appearing in products like Slack's message alerts, GitHub's pull request notifications, and banking apps' transaction confirmations. Developers implement these systems to deliver real-time updates in dashboards, display form submission feedback, and show interactive toast messages for user actions. Practical scenarios include showing success/error messages after API calls, displaying system alerts in admin panels, and creating temporary banners for new feature announcements. Mastering notification patterns enables building professional, user-friendly interfaces that keep users informed without disrupting their workflow.
